output.summary: A climbing flowering vine native to the Mediterranean, Central Europe and southwestern Asia. It attaches to supports with tendrils and bears clustered berries that may be green, red or purple in cultivated plants. Grapes are eaten fresh or dried, their leaves are used in many cuisines, and juice is fermented into wine or vinegar.
output.edibilityNote: Grapes are eaten fresh or dried; leaves are used in cooking; juice is made into wine and vinegar.
